use.flag: Use gpgme for OpenPGP verification of gpkg binary packages
Build the curl source tree in src/curl

Clone of net-misc/curl's psl flag. A static build (USE=static) without internal-libs links the system libcurl statically together with everything it was built against so that means psl brings in libpsl, libidn2 and libunistring with static-libs. We do not necessarily need them for portage-utils, by default psl USE is off.

In static builds (USE=static), use libarchive's libxml2 XML backend, which pulls libxml2 and ICU into the static binary (much larger). When disabled, the static build uses libarchive's small expat backend instead. No effect on non-static builds.
